title: 高盛闪辉年初强年中压：政策加码刚好够到4.5%，谁在定这个目标？
speaker: Hui Shan

segments.en: All right, let's bring in Huai Shan, Chief China economist at Goldman Sachs, so how much stimulus are you expecting?
segments.zh: 好，我们请来高盛首席中国经济学家闪辉，你预计会有多大力度的政策支持？

segments.en: A little whole lot, just enough to get to 4.5% growth.
segments.zh: 不多不少，刚好够达到4.5%的增长。

segments.en: We have seen this movie over and over again, that beginning of the year is strong, middle of the year is challenging, and the government to come up with the marginal easing just to get to growth target, and this year is no exception.
segments.zh: 这个剧情我们反复看过：年初强劲，年中承压，然后政策端推出边际宽松，刚好够到增长目标，今年也不例外。

segments.en: Why is that, and why has that been the case? I think the broader backdrop is that one, exports I'm doing pretty well, exceptional, right?
segments.zh: 为什么会这样，为什么一直如此？我认为更大的背景是，第一，出口表现相当不错，甚至可以说是异常亮眼。

segments.en: Number two, fiscal constraints are getting more and more challenging. If you talk to, you guys have been veterans of watching China, but if you talk to somebody who never covered China before, and you show them the augmented fiscal deficit in double digit of percent of GDP for the past 10 years, that person is not going to say, bazooka, more fiscal.
segments.zh: 第二，财政约束越来越有挑战。如果跟一个从没研究过中国的人说，过去十年广义财政赤字占GDP比重一直保持两位数，他不会说"上火箭炮、加大财政"。

segments.en: Right, right, right. So I think a fiscal pressure is also real and binding.
segments.zh: 对，对，对。所以我认为财政压力也是真实且具有约束力的。
